question: Which Constitutional Amendment introduced the compulsory education to children between the age group of 6 to 14?
solution:
The correct answer is __**86th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 86th Amendment Act

 
• This amend act made elementary education a fundamental right.
 
• The newly-added Article 21-A declares that the State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of 6 to 14 years.
